method: An open --freq 60 fabric image carries the (60,8) PLL preamble. SRAM firmware runs the recovered SYS_SwitchPLLClock sequence (enable HSE and PLL, spin to lock, select PLL as system/fabric clock), records MTIME (0x0200bff8, MTIME_PSC=0 so it counts system clocks) at the switch, then publishes live MTIME. OpenOCD resumes for a known host window, halts mid-run at the PLL clock, and reads elapsed MTIME. Because MTIME counts the system clock, only the host wall-clock is a clock-independent reference.
scope: Qualifies the (60,8) PLL output frequency on silicon: it locks, is selected as the system/fabric clock, and runs the MCU at ~60 MHz (about six times the 10 MHz HSI/MTIME reference). Solving measured = true*(T-offset)/T for the 1000 ms and 4000 ms windows gives true=60.0 MHz and a fixed 26.7 ms host resume/halt offset. Does not qualify other PLL outputs, phase, duty-cycle, feedback, or bypass. The DAP link survived at 60 MHz across three runs; the earlier bounded DP-IDR-read failure was not reproduced.
rails: SRAM-only, board reset per run, no flash, no option byte, no wiring, no POR
